clue.text: Not all the study of Scripture and the Church can show how the Pope is crowned

indicators.note: not all of the word 'the' is used, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: RI is religious instruction, the school study of Scripture
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A remark on what theology and the Church can reveal about papal coronation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not all' trims 'the' to TH. The papal tiara is a triple crown, so the Pope was crowned three times over.
explanation.definitionFit: The papal tiara has three tiers of crowns, so the Pope wears a crown three times over.

clue.text: Portillo and I look out over the capital

indicators.note: knocked over, so the remaining letters are tumbled into a new order
the word for look is put out of Portillo

parts.note: lo is an old word for look

explanation.surface: A politician and companion gazing over a city.
explanation.walkthrough: Michael Portillo is a British politician turned broadcaster. 'look out' removes LO, leaving PORTIL; 'over' rearranges PORTIL + I.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is the capital city of Libya.

clue.text: The Artist Formerly Known As Princess

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
nee introduces a former name, typically a maiden name

explanation.surface: A nod to the pop star once styled the Artist Formerly Known As Prince.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the singer Prince's alias, with the clue's last word extended to 'Princess'.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranee is the wife or widow of a rajah, an Indian princess or queen.

clue.text: Introduction of cane to speed up discipline

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word cane

parts.note: to hasten is to speed up

explanation.surface: Bringing in the cane to hurry along school punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To chasten is to discipline or correct, often by punishment.

clue.text: Food science included hallucinogen

indicators.note: the food word has the science abbreviation included within it

parts.note: a meal is food
SC is a standard abbreviation for science

explanation.surface: A food science course that somehow featured a hallucinogenic drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Mescal is a cactus whose buttons give the hallucinogen mescaline, and the name is used for the drug.

clue.text: Demonstrate oriental depravity without name

parts.note: E stands for east, oriental

indicators.note: used in the old sense of outside, so the depravity word surrounds name

parts.note: vice is wickedness or depravity

explanation.surface: Showing up eastern wickedness that lacks a name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: VICE goes around N.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a quality is to show or reveal it clearly.

clue.text: Burning 18's leader, interrupting the work of God

indicators.note: the leading letter breaks into the work-of-God word

parts.note: creation is what God made, in Genesis

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the answer to 18 down, the victims clue

explanation.surface: Martyrs' burning disrupting the divine work.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 down is MARTYRS; its first letter goes inside CREATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Cremation is the burning of a dead body to ashes.

clue.text: Rope that's hoisted beam in the country

indicators.note: the turned beam word goes in the country word

parts.note: land is a country

indicators.note: raised up, which in a down clue reads the letters bottom to top

parts.note: a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: A rope that lifts a beam somewhere in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'hoisted' means read upwards, so the beam word is reversed before going into the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A lanyard is a short rope or cord, especially one used on a ship.

clue.text: Rider's credential

definitions.meaning: a rider is a clause added as a condition or proviso
a certificate showing that someone has completed training

explanation.surface: A jockey's paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a limiting proviso added to a statement and a certificate of achieved skill.

clue.text: Oven not altogether unlikely to be overturned

indicators.note: turned over means the run of letters is read backwards in this down-the-page sense
only part of the word unlikely is taken, a run from inside it

explanation.surface: An oven that is not entirely unlikely to tip over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not altogether' takes NLIK from inside 'unlikely'; 'to be overturned' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiln is an oven for firing pottery or drying materials.

clue.text: Pulses from a sunbaked island

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters, rearranged

explanation.surface: Beans grown on a sun-scorched isle.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange A, SUNBAKED and I (island); 'from' is the only signal that the letters are reworked.
explanation.definitionFit: Aduki beans are small red legumes, and pulses are the edible seeds of such plants.

clue.text: Making sense of the news in bed

indicators.note: the news word sits in the bed word

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
gen is British slang for information or news

explanation.surface: Someone finding the news sensible while reading it in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is British slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: A cogent argument is convincing and logical, one that makes sense.

clue.text: Need another 24 hours, alas!

parts.note: to need something is to lack it
one more day, a day

explanation.surface: A harried person sighing that they need one more day.
explanation.definitionFit: Lackaday is an archaic exclamation of regret or sorrow, like alas.

clue.text: Kin to Sheffielder (not senior) forging a piece of cutlery

indicators.note: forging shapes metal anew, so these letters are hammered into a new order
the word for senior is not included in Sheffielder

parts.note: an elder is someone senior

explanation.surface: A Sheffield metalworker's relative forging cutlery, Sheffield being famous for its steel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not senior' takes ELDER from Sheffielder, leaving SHEFFI; 'forging' rearranges KIN + SHEFFI. Sheffield is the English city famed for steel cutlery.
explanation.definitionFit: A fish knife is a blunt, broad-bladed knife used at table for eating fish.

clue.text: Emission of foul air? Painter is swamping it with oxygen

indicators.note: the painter's name engulfs the other letters

parts.note: Frans Hals was a Dutch portrait painter
taken as written
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
taken as written

explanation.surface: A painter is overwhelmed by gassy oxygen fumes.
explanation.walkthrough: Frans Hals is the painter crosswords use most; the question mark flags bad breath described as foul air given off.
explanation.definitionFit: Halitosis is bad breath, a stale smell breathed out of the mouth.

clue.text: Twist and blow

definitions.meaning: moving air, as when it blows

explanation.definitionFit: Spelt the same, one word means to coil and, said differently, another means moving air.

clue.text: Part of a leg of veal

definitions.meaning: the fleshy back of the lower leg
veal is the meat of a young bovine, so the animal is its source

explanation.definitionFit: The muscle at the back of the shin shares its name with the young cow whose meat is veal.

clue.text: Bird inhaling woman's smoke

indicators.note: drawing in, so the bird word takes the woman word inside

parts.note: a coot is a water bird
her is the possessive for a woman

explanation.surface: A bird puffing on a lady's cigar.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a cigar cut square at both ends, something smoked.

clue.text: Ground cummin seed endlessly promoting consensus

definitions.note: read as a noun phrase, the promoting of consensus

indicators.note: spice that is ground is crushed and broken up, so the letters are scrambled
the word seed loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Grinding cumin seed as a way of bringing people together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims seed to SEE; 'Ground' rearranges CUMMIN + SEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecumenism is the movement seeking unity and agreement among the Christian churches.

clue.text: One god of war capturing another's victims

indicators.note: one god's name holds the other's inside it

parts.note: Mars is the Roman god of war
Tyr is the Norse god of war, another such god

explanation.surface: A war god taking prisoners from another war god.
explanation.walkthrough: Both gods are war gods, one Roman and one Norse, so 'another' is fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Martyrs are people killed or made to suffer for their beliefs, victims of persecution.

clue.text: S-surgical appliance protecting a composer

indicators.note: the appliance word wraps around the letter A

parts.note: a truss is a padded support worn for a hernia

explanation.surface: A stammered mention of a surgical brace shielding a musician.
explanation.walkthrough: The stammer gives S; TRUSS surrounds A.
explanation.definitionFit: Strauss is the name of composers such as Johann and Richard.

clue.text: Inspector left a scrap

parts.note: Inspector Morse is the TV detective

explanation.surface: A police inspector abandoning a fragment.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspector Morse is a British TV detective from Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: A morsel is a small piece or scrap, especially of food.

clue.text: Vegetable or tree decomposing in sack

indicators.note: the rearranged tree goes in the dismissal word

parts.note: to give someone the boot is to sack them

indicators.note: breaking down, so the letters of tree are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A vegetable, or a tree, rotting inside a sack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decomposing' rearranges the tree; 'or' is only a link. Sack means dismiss, so the boot.
explanation.definitionFit: Beetroot is a root vegetable, a dark red edible root.

clue.text: Flash bang

definitions.meaning: a news flash is a brief news bulletin
a loud explosive noise, as of a gun

explanation.definitionFit: A news bulletin and the sharp sound of a gunshot are both called by this one word.

clue.text: Indication of rank of Queen's Musician

parts.note: a pip is a star on an officer's shoulder showing rank
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Insignia on a royal bandsman's uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A piper is a musician who plays the bagpipes or a pipe.

clue.text: Is right-winger following others to the council?

indicators.note: the right-winger comes after the other pieces

parts.note: cons are the points on the other side, the others set against the pros
taken as written
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician following the crowd into a council meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' puts the Is-plus-Tory pair after the others. Cons are the arguments against, the other side to pros; a Tory is a British Conservative.

clue.text: Penny's striking expression of discontent

parts.note: P stands for a penny in British money
workers on strike are out

explanation.surface: Penny pulling a face in displeasure.
explanation.walkthrough: Workers who are striking are said to be 'out'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pushing out the lips sulkily is a facial sign of displeasure.

clue.text: A little struggle lets us loose

indicators.note: set loose, the letters are freed to rearrange

explanation.surface: A small scuffle that allows us to break free.
explanation.definitionFit: A tussle is a short vigorous fight or scuffle, a minor struggle.

clue.text: Seaman taking Murdoch for God

parts.note: OS is an ordinary seaman
Iris Murdoch was a British novelist

explanation.surface: A sailor treating a novelist as a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Osiris was the Egyptian god of the dead and the underworld.
